title: Scenario
description: A scenario injects deterministic, non-real-time context into the game state for each test run.

epoch_phase.description: Phase injected into game_state.epoch_phase. 'eclipse' lifts the cursed_idol block.

glyph_index.description: Which glyph PNG to use (0-3). Determines the expected glyph_key_id.

expected_glyph_key_id.description: Pre-computed (width // 8) % 16 for this glyph_index. Used by the oracle and tests to verify the policy computes the correct value.
